zh: 龍淵閣。天劍譜與三道封印，擺在殷九霄的案前，已經七天了。
七天了。鏡王，你的地機卷，還要讓九霄等多久？
等不到的。殷閣主，你就算等到死，也只是一顆，等著被吃掉的棋。
陰陽郎君。龍淵閣，什麼時候變成誰都能進來的地方了？
從你把三道封印擺在桌上的那一天開始。哈哈，天下人都在看著你這張桌子。
好好好。只是送你一句話：翻開那本書之前，先想一想，誰最希望你翻開它。
哈哈哈！生氣了？生氣，就說明你也怕了！
洛無塵死後第七天。四個人，往鏡湖的方向走。
鏡湖？就憑老和尚一句話，我們就要去鏡湖？
慧明去了鏡湖，就再也沒有回來。這是我們唯一的線索。
洛先生如果還在，他一定早就去了。
別提他了。一提他，我就想砍人。
各位！各位！萬佛峰出了大事！
慧明不是死了嗎？我們都看見了！
他說他根本沒死！大會上是他被人下毒，裝死才逃了出來。現在他在萬佛峰上，指控燕姑娘下毒，還說……是佛者指使的！
佛者指使？……這下子，誰都說不清了。
一個死人回來，指控兩個人。他回來得，太是時候了。
你們要去萬佛峰？那個回來的慧明，是假的。
鏡湖月清寒。十年前，我是千面鏡王的徒弟。
他的武功，有兩樣，天下無人能及。一樣，是千面術——他能戴上任何一個死人的臉。
另一樣，是替身傀儡。一具和真人一模一樣的傀儡，會說話，會走路，連倒下的樣子都一樣。
它騙得過所有人的眼睛。只有一個破綻：它冷得太快。
洛先生說過！那具屍首，冷得太快，不像一個剛死的人！
真正的慧明，七天前就死在鏡湖了。是我，親手埋了他。
在大會上倒下的，是一具傀儡。替傀儡舉杯的，才是鏡王本人。
……殺青松子的那一掌，也是左手。
可是，我憑什麼相信妳？妳是鏡王的徒弟，說不定，妳就是下一張臉。
你不必信我。到了萬佛峰，你自己看。
因為他殺了我的師妹。也因為……他騙了我十年。
師父！弟子差一點，就死在龍淵閣了！
是燕飛霜在酒裡下毒！弟子裝死，才逃過一劫。師父，您為什麼……要讓她這麼做？
小師父，你說佛者指使燕飛霜殺你。佛者，為什麼要殺自己的徒弟？
因為……因為弟子知道了，師父的秘密。
就是她！就是她在酒裡下毒！
慧明，你看著我的眼睛說。
慧明，你還記得，七天前在鏡湖，你最後跟我說的話嗎？
你不記得。因為那一天，是你殺了他。
說這麼多做什麼。是真是假，一刀便知！
慧明，從小用右手抄經。阿彌陀佛……你不是慧明。
月清寒。十年不見，妳還是這麼，不聽話。
十年前，我聽了你的話。所以，我失去了一切。
千面之下無真我。你們拆穿了一張臉，本王，還有九百九十九張。
施主。這一掌，是老衲的右手。
阿彌陀佛。你的眼睛沒有錯，錯的是你看見的那張臉。這句話，是洛無塵說的。
你死了，還是每一次都對。這比你活著，更讓人生氣。
不必謝我。鏡王拆穿了，他背後的人，還在。
殷九霄也只是一顆棋子。鏡王跪的，是幽冥。
天劍譜在殷九霄手上，地機卷在鏡王手上……兩卷要是合在一起……
那就是，幽冥等了二十年的那一天。
……這枚蓮花玉牌？他讓你，把這個給我？
他死前三天，來過鏡湖。他說，七天之後，會有一個不說話的人，把這個交給我。
他說：「到那時候，請妳帶他們上萬佛峰，拆穿那張臉。」
他死前三天，就算到了今天？
他算到了今天……那他有沒有算到，他自己會死？
洛先生……東西，我已經放好了，放在殷九霄的桌上，誰都沒發現。
你說過，七天之後，你會告訴我為什麼……今天，已經是第七天了。
帝君，本王的臉，被拆穿了。
在殷九霄手中。三道封印，也在他那裡。地機卷，在本王這裡。
天機策只有在合一的那一刻，才能被奪走。讓他合起來，讓他翻開。
等他翻開的時候——本帝，親自去取。
鏡中真相大白，鏡外的棋局，卻才剛剛走到最後一步。
龍淵閣上，殷九霄將翻開天機策。他會看見什麼？
en: The Dragon Abyss Pavilion. For seven days the Heavenly Sword Manual and the three seals have lain on Yin Jiuxiao’s desk.
Seven days. Mirror King — how much longer must I wait for your Earthly Scroll?
You’ll never have it. Pavilion Master, wait till you die — you are only a piece waiting to be taken.
The Yin-Yang Gentleman. Since when has the Pavilion been a place anyone may walk into?
Since the day you laid three seals on your desk. Ha ha — the whole world is watching that desk of yours.
All right, all right. Just one thing before I go: before you open that book, think about who most wants you to.
Ha ha ha! Angry? Then you’re afraid too!
...Who most wants me to open it?
The seventh day after Luo Wuchen’s death. Four people walk toward the Mirror Lake.
The Mirror Lake? On one word from an old monk, we go to the Mirror Lake?
Huiming went to the Mirror Lake and never came back. It is the only thread we have.
If Master Luo were still here, he would have gone long ago.
Don’t talk about him. Every time you do, I want to cut someone.
Everyone! Everyone! Something has happened on the Peak!
Isn’t Huiming dead? We all saw it!
He says he never died! Someone poisoned him at the council and he played dead to escape. Now he’s up on the Peak, accusing Miss Yan of the poison — and saying the Buddha put her up to it!
The Buddha put her up to it? ...Now no one can untangle anything.
A dead man comes back and accuses two people. He has come back at exactly the right moment.
The cold moon shines on the Mirror Lake without a sound;
all of me cold and clear, untouched by dust.
You are going to the Peak? That Huiming who has come back is false.
Yue Qinghan of the Mirror Lake. Ten years ago, I was the Mirror King’s disciple.
Two of his arts are matched by no one under heaven. One is the Thousand Faces — he can wear the face of anyone who has died.
The other is the puppet double. A puppet so like the man that it speaks, walks — and even falls down the same way.
It fools every eye. It has only one flaw: it grows cold too fast.
Master Luo said that! The body went cold too fast — not like a man who had only just died!
The real Huiming died at the Mirror Lake before the council. I buried him myself.
What fell at the council was a puppet. The one who lifted the cup for it was the Mirror King himself.
And lifted it with his left hand?
...The palm that killed Qingsong Zi was the left hand too.
But why should I believe you? You were the Mirror King’s disciple. For all I know, you are his next face.
You need not believe me. Go to the Peak, and see for yourself.
Because he killed my younger sister in the school. And because... he lied to me for ten years.
Master! I very nearly died in the Pavilion!
It was Yan Feishuang who poisoned the wine! I only escaped by playing dead. Master, why... why did you let her do it?
Young master — you say the Buddha set Yan Feishuang to kill you. Why would the Buddha kill his own disciple?
Because... because I learned my master’s secret.
That’s her! She’s the one who poisoned the wine!
Huiming. Look me in the eye and say it.
...I... I saw it with my own eyes!
Huiming — do you remember the last thing you said to me, at the Mirror Lake, before the council?
You don’t remember. Because that was the day you killed him.
Why so many words? True or false — one cut will tell!
His left! He caught the blade with his left hand!
Huiming copied sutras with his right hand from the time he was a child. Amitabha... you are not Huiming.
Yue Qinghan. Ten years, and you are as disobedient as ever.
Ten years ago I did as you told me. And so I lost everything.
Beneath a thousand faces there is no true self. You have torn off one face — this king has nine hundred and ninety-nine more.
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
Nine Folds of the Cold Moon!
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
My friend. This palm is my right hand.
...A fine palm. A pity it cannot kill this king.
Amitabha. Your eyes did not deceive you; the face did. Those were Luo Wuchen’s words.
You’re dead, and you’re still right every time. That’s even more infuriating than when you were alive.
Don’t thank me. The Mirror King is unmasked, but the one behind him is still there.
The one behind him? Yin Jiuxiao?
Yin Jiuxiao is only a piece on the board too. The Mirror King kneels to the Netherworld.
The Heavenly Sword Manual is in Yin Jiuxiao’s hands, the Earthly Scroll in the Mirror King’s... if the two halves come together...
That will be the day the Netherworld has waited twenty years for.
...This lotus token? He wanted you to give it to me?
Three days before he died, he came to the Mirror Lake. He said that seven days later, a man who never speaks would give me this.
He said: “When that day comes, take them to the Peak, and tear that face away.”
Three days before he died, he foresaw today?
He foresaw today... then did he foresee his own death?
Master Luo... I put the thing where you said — on Yin Jiuxiao’s desk. Nobody noticed.
You said that after seven days you’d tell me why... today is the seventh day.
Are you really there or not?
My Emperor. This king’s face has been torn away.
One face, no more. And the Heavenly Sword Manual?
In Yin Jiuxiao’s hands, with the three seals. The Earthly Scroll is with me.
The Stratagem can be seized only at the moment it is made whole. Let him put it together. Let him open it.
And when he opens it — I shall come and take it myself.
The truth in the mirror is out; but outside it, the game has only now reached its last move.
In the Pavilion, Yin Jiuxiao is about to open the Stratagem. What will he see?
